_note: TAXO-INDUCE-1107: owner-run taxonomy induction (vera/taxonomy_induction.py, scripts/taxonomy_induce.py). Read-only dry run by default; --write inserts DRAFT registry rows only; activation is the owner's batch approval (scripts/taxonomy_approve.py).
_calibration_note: PROVISIONAL, 2026-11-07: not measured on real data (agents have no DB read; work/CORPUS-COUNTS-OWNER-1107 has scripts but no output yet). scan_max_documents, chunks_per_doc, chunk_chars, max_clusters_*, max_iter, keyphrases, anchor_terms, max_proposals and naming.* are work bounds. Decision values: min_docs 3 (a proposed topic must cover at least 3 documents), min_similarity 0.12 (cosine of a chunk to a cluster centroid, below = noise), max_df_share 0.25 (a term in more than a quarter of the chunks is treated as a stop word), min_df 3, subtopic_min_chunks 30, min_chunk_votes 1. The BM25 acceptance value is micro_topic.count_min_score.anchor_bm25.scholarly (2.0, PROVISIONAL). Calibrate from the first owner dry-run manifest: cluster sizes, cohesion spread, keyphrase quality and the projected not-matched share; change a value when clusters are boilerplate (raise min_docs or lower max_df_share) or the projected share stays high (lower min_similarity).
